iRequestDologon
ONLINE · BARANGAY DOLOGON

BARANGAY DOLOGON · MARAMAG, BUKIDNON

iRequestDologon

Official online portal for barangay document requests.
Fast, secure, and paperless.

Request a Document Online
DISCOVER MORE

WHO WE ARE

About Barangay Dologon

Dologon is a major, populous barangay in the municipality of Maramag, Bukidnon, with 13,828 residents (2020 Census), representing approximately 12.77% of the town's population.

It is best known for hosting the Central Mindanao University (CMU) in its Musuan area, making it a critical hub for education, agriculture, and local commerce.

The barangay's motto: "For the good of Dologon, We Serve and We Remain."

13,828

Residents

2020 Census

12.77%

of Maramag

Population share

12

Puroks

Subdivisions

282–458m

Elevation

Above sea level

Education

Home to Central Mindanao University — the premier agricultural school in Mindanao, located in Sitio Musuan. Dologon National High School serves the local community.

Economy

Agriculture is dominant, with rural agri-based livelihood projects for residents and Indigenous Peoples (IPs) across the 12 puroks.

Landmarks

Musuan Peak is a prominent geographic feature known for its natural beauty. The CMU campus is a landmark destination in the area.

WHAT WE OFFER

Our Services

Request official barangay documents online and pick them up at the barangay office — no more long queues.

Barangay Clearance

Required for employment, business permits, and other government transactions. Certifies that you have no pending case in the barangay.

₱130.00
1–2 business days
Certificate of Residency

Proves that you are a bona fide resident of Barangay Dologon. Required for school enrollment, scholarships, and legal transactions.

₱130.00
1–2 business days
Certificate of Indigency

Certifies financial need for PhilHealth, educational assistance, and medical assistance programs. Free for qualified residents.

Free / Exempt
1–2 business days
How It Works
01
Walk In

Visit the barangay office or inform the secretary of your document request.

02
Submit Request

The secretary encodes your information and submits the document request.

03
Payment

Pay the document fee at the barangay collector's window.

04
Pick Up

Once signed and sealed by the Barangay Captain, your document is ready for pickup.

FIND US

Location

ADDRESS

Barangay Dologon, Maramag, Bukidnon 8714, Philippines

OFFICE HOURS

Monday – Friday · 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM

CONTACT

Barangay Dologon Office

EMAIL

support@irequestdologon.gov.ph

Landmark

Near the Central Mindanao University (CMU) gate, Sitio Musuan area, Maramag, Bukidnon.

ANDROID APPLICATION

Download iRequestDologon

Take the barangay portal with you — install the official Android app and request documents directly from your phone, anytime, anywhere.

WHAT'S INCLUDED
Submit document requests without a browser
Real-time status notifications on your phone
Secure login — your data stays encrypted
View and track all your past requests in one place
Works even on slow internet connections
Lightweight & fast — minimal system resources
SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS

OS

RAM

NETWORK

How to Install
01
Download

Tap the Download button above to save the APK file to your Android device.

02
Allow Install

Go to Settings → Security → enable "Install from Unknown Sources" for your browser.

03
Open APK

Tap the downloaded .apk file from your notifications or Downloads folder.

04

Log in with your registered account and start submitting document requests.
